read.thesis: NextEra grew adjusted EPS 9.7% to $1.24 with a 36.7 GW renewables and storage backlog and 2026 EPS guidance of $3.92–$4.02 held, targeting the high end; federal hubs are capital-light.

utilisation.quote: Wind resource for the third quarter of 2026 was approximately 101% of the long-term average versus only 90% in the third quarter of 2025.

capex.quote: we expect FPL's full year capital investments to be approximately $12 billion.

triggers.label: 2026 EPS held, targeting high end
triggers.quote: Our 2026 adjusted earnings per share expectations range of $3.92 to $4.02 remains unchanged, and we are targeting the high end of that range.

triggers.label: Renewables backlog 36.7 GW
triggers.quote: our backlog now totals nearly 36.7 gigawatts

guidance.quote: Our 2026 adjusted earnings per share expectations range of $3.92 to $4.02 remains unchanged, and we are targeting the high end of that range.
We expect to grow adjusted earnings per share at a compound annual growth rate of 8%+ through 2032
we expect FPL's full year capital investments to be approximately $12 billion.
It's why we raised our large load expectations from 6 gigawatts to 8 gigawatts by 2032
we remain consistent in the range that we have provided of roughly $12 billion-$17 billion of total equity needs through 2032.
